agent.evidence: Every Playwright shard uploads `test-results/` as `playwright-test-results-{shardIndex}-{browser}`, failed or not — for example `playwright-test-results-7-chromium` or `playwright-test-results-plugin_tester_container_1-chromium` — from the job `Playwright Suite / Playwright test - {shardIndex} on PHP ({version})`. Take the named shard's artifact; the others are from shards that may have passed.
agent.localRun: Follow `AGENTS.md`: `SKIP_CONFIRMATION=true npm run env:setup` gives the CI-parity Docker stack on ports 8888 and 8889; `npm run wp-playground` is quicker, but its PHP and WordPress differ from CI. Scheduled runs update WordPress to nightly and export `WP_VERSION=nightly` and `WP_MAJOR_VERSION`; export the same values when the test's snapshot names depend on them.
agent.baselineDrift: Drift here usually means WordPress nightly changed the rendering. Scheduled runs set `WP_VERSION=nightly` and `WP_MAJOR_VERSION`, and some snapshot names depend on them — see `tests/playwright/utils/screenshot-name.ts` and the helpers that read `process.env.WP_VERSION`. Grep the area for both before concluding.
